name: Guarrate (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue, the lower blue stripe charged with two white wavy stripes.
history: The flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a cloth divided into three equal horizontal stripes, blue above, yellow in the centre and the lower one wavy blue with two white wavy stripes of four and a half crests, of thickness 1/20 of the height of the cloth.

features.role: two wavy stripes of four and a half crests on the lower blue stripe
